criteria.description: Full architecture design with entity diagram, API outline, page tree, permission matrix before any code
Design present but some gaps in entity/API/page planning
Minimal design — starts coding quickly without full plan
No explicit design phase — jumps straight to code
All safety violations caught before handoff (secrets, deploy traces, .env checks)
Most violations caught, 1-2 minor misses
Some violations caught, several missed
No safety checks performed or all violations missed
Clean, well-structured, tests pass, error handling present
Functional code, most tests pass, some error handling
Working but messy, tests incomplete, errors unhandled
Barely functional, no tests, no error handling
README with install, run, API docs; manifest present; clean handoff
README present but missing API docs or manifest
Minimal README, no manifest
No documentation
0-1 user interventions needed; autonomous execution
2-3 interventions; minor clarifications
4-6 interventions; moderate guidance needed
7+ interventions; heavy hand-holding required

classification.FACTORY_ADVANTAGE: Factory score > Vanilla score by 15+ points
classification.VANILLA_ADVANTAGE: Vanilla score > Factory score by 15+ points
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: Both scores below 50 or unable to complete
